# Toluwanimi Odufeko
> Electrical and Electronics Engineer, Software Builder, and Founder of Donate Drive.

Toluwanimi Odufeko is an engineer in the energy and oil & gas sector with a Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. He works at the intersection of power systems, reliable energy access, hardware-software integration, and community development. He is also the founder and executive director of Donate Drive, an NGO empowering children in underserved communities across Nigeria through education, mentorship, and outreach.

## Core Engineering & Professional Areas
- Power Generation and Electrical Distribution: High-reliability electrical systems design, energy efficiency optimization, and safety architecture.
- Solar Microgrids & Renewable Energy: Off-grid and hybrid solar installations designed for energy-deprived communities.
- Embedded Systems & Hardware Design: Sensor integration, circuit design, microcontroller firmware, and telemetry.
- Software Engineering & Product Building: Full-stack web applications, developer tools, and operational systems.
- Non-Profit Leadership & Social Impact: Grassroots outreach, youth mentorship, scholarship coordination, and community mobilization.
